items.title: Coinbase makes a bigger push into crypto derivatives
items.summary:
Scott Melker discusses Coinbase's (COIN) latest offering, Deribit options and perpetuals, to its institutional customers. 

"The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.title: Coinbase Sinks 9% as Bitcoin Falls Below $76,000
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoinbase shares fell 9% today as Bitcoin dropped below $76,000 in a broad market sell-off. Coinbase fell almost three times as far as the S&P 500 because its fees and earnings move with Bitcoin.
